svg.title: Batch norm at training and test time
svg.desc: Training takes mean and variance from the current mini-batch and also updates running averages; test uses the stored averages; both use the same learned gamma and beta.
svg.text: Test: statistics from storage, no batch
batch mean and variance (divide by m)
scale and shift: o = γ x̄ + β
scale and shift: o = γ x̄ + β
every training step: update running averages
EMA ← (1 − α) EMA + α μB​ (same for σ²)
Training uses batch statistics, so each output depends on the other samples in the batch. At test time one input
has no usable batch variance, so the stored averages are used and the output for x = 6 is always 0.837, whatever
